# Sources and firmware differences

Evidence reviewed October 16, 2026. These references target the current event
badge, not every release named "U26".

## Source order

1. For app and menu behavior, inspect readable source on the target badge.
   Do not read or copy its credentials or personal saved data.
2. For electrical details, use `badger/home/hardware/README.md` and its U26
   schematic. Do not assume stock Tufty wiring.
3. Use matching first-party firmware modules and U26 examples for exact APIs.
4. Use repository apps and website examples only after checking their version.
   A newer repository commit does not prove newer installed firmware.

When sources conflict, record the difference. Do not merge incompatible APIs
or replace observed behavior with older documentation.

## Current event menu: custom icons are not supported yet

On the inspected event badge, `apps/menu/app.py` imports `ICONS` from the
menu's `icons` module. `App.__init__` selects a built-in entry by app folder
name, or `default` for an unknown name. App discovery uses the same mapping.
This menu does not load an app's `icon.png`.

The readable mapping is `apps/menu/src/icons.py`, generated by firmware tools.
This is menu-owned data, not an app asset or a supported custom-icon upload
interface. Do not edit it, replace the menu, flash firmware, or rename an app
to borrow an existing icon as part of an ordinary app request.

Keep the generated 24x24 `icon.png` for previews only. A preview image does not
change the badge menu. Images displayed inside an app are not affected.

The user identifies this behavior as the latest event firmware. No exact
release identifier was found in the inspected mounted files. Recheck this
rule before claiming support on a different firmware version.

Inspected source SHA-256 fingerprints:

- `apps/menu/app.py`: `8bf0df57633f99b21b875536d191cf43c22658f17ead533f23570bcedafe1608`
- `apps/menu/src/icons.py`: `8823b7deb65bc6ae5f8868be77101f777a2a1c43d83e5cf2671e6d66f2eef3c7`

## Repository evidence

| Repository and revision | Useful sources | Known limit |
|---|---|---|
| `badger/home` at `26f4f142efa9b437eec0d56b7751d77a3cc4dcc1` | `README.md`, `badge/AGENTS.md`, U26 apps, `hardware/README.md`, `hardware/USB_SERIAL.md` | Its menu still loads app-local PNG icons; that is not current event menu behavior |
| `badger/badgerfactory` at `a20a55bf6d932c7815151cf7ee5de9c0b739744a` | App behavior, assets, networking and game structure | Many apps, including the inspected menu, still use the legacy 2025 API |
| `badger/badger.github.io` at `b3b4397e126753574abd26ea4a4917772ffa85fe` | `src/content/build-guides/`, local project and USB workflows, simulator module examples | Website previews do not prove physical badge behavior |

The archived `badge25/` simulator in `badger/home` does not implement current
U26 graphics and controls. Upstream `pimoroni/tufty2350`, `pimoroni/badgeware-docs`,
and Badgeware simulators can help with platform details, but do not prove
GitHub's custom wiring, radios, touch controls, or installed firmware behavior.

For an API not demonstrated in the bundled references, inspect a matching
implementation before generating code. Static validation is not an API
allow-list, an electrical check, or a runtime compatibility guarantee.
